title: Big-M and hull bounds of one disjunctive model
heading: gdp.hull Writes a Copy per Disjunct and Needs Every Variable Bounded
cases: on a town fleet, the big-M bound is at most the hull bound, which is at most the optimum and at least the all-repair cost
on a city fleet the same order holds
each bound is the LP relaxation of the transformed model, so both sit strictly below the optimum here
